hooks.command:
jq -n --arg arch "$(curl -s --max-time 8 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/foulox/tigerwolves/Architecture-Overview.md || echo 'fetch failed')" --arg contrib "$(curl -s --max-time 8 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/foulox/tigerwolves/Contributing.md || echo 'fetch failed')" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("# tigerwolves wiki (auto-loaded at session start)

## Architecture Overview
" + $arch + "

## Contributing
" + $contrib)}}'

input=$(cat)
cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
if ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh pr (create|edit)'; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'
  exit 0
fi
bodyfile=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE -- '--body-file[= ]+[^ ]+' | sed -E 's/--body-file[= ]+//' | head -1)
if [ -n "$bodyfile" ]; then
  body=$(cat "$bodyfile" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
else
  body="$cmd"
fi
if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "Verified by Claude" && printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "Please verify manually"; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'
else
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"PR body is missing the required split: both a \"Verified by Claude\" and a \"Please verify manually\" section are required. Use .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md as the starting structure (see wiki Contributing.md, PR test plan section). This convention was silently dropped for a month before being caught on PR #286 - do not skip it."}}'
fi
